blocks.text: Hand Tufted Modern Rugs(Process) : They are pile rugs where the yarns are wrapped around the warp threads, but are not tied in a knot like hand tufted rugs are. Rather, the pile is secured in place by coating the back of the rug with a latex type adhesive. Usually a canvas backing is applied to the back of the carpet to create a finished look New Zealand wool for softness and durability. – Designed in Stockholm, handmade in Hand Tufted cut pile design. 12 -14mm thickness.
